audicao.title: Understanding hearing
audicao.paragraph1: Hearing is one of the most important senses for communication and social interaction.
audicao.paragraph2: It allows us to identify sounds, understand speech and perceive our surroundings.
audicao.paragraph3: Over time, hearing can be affected by factors such as age, noise exposure, infections or genetic conditions.

beneficios.title: Benefits of hearing aids
beneficios.paragraph1: Using a hearing aid significantly improves daily communication, allowing better speech understanding.
beneficios.paragraph2: With proper sound amplification, users can participate more actively in conversations and social activities.
beneficios.paragraph3: In addition, continuous use of hearing aids contributes to autonomy, quality of life, and emotional well-being.
